nodes.description: External payable mint entry point RedPanda.buyNFT(uint quantity); guarded by nonReentrant, checks contractPaused, _startSale, supply limit 10000 and 0<quantity<11, then mints tokens to msg.sender.
External nonReentrant mint entry point RedPanda.birth(); mints one token to msg.sender after supply and sale checks.
External privileged mint RedPanda.devMint(uint count, address recipient); requires MINTER_ROLE for caller and mints count tokens to an arbitrary recipient.
RedPanda.pauseContract(bool _paused); role-gated MINTER_ROLE switch that toggles contractPaused.
ERC721.setBaseURI(string newURI); role-gated MINTER_ROLE setter writing the baseURI state variable.
RedPanda.startSale(); role-gated one-shot switch setting _startSale = true.
ERC721._mint(address to, uint256 tokenId); internal core mint routine incrementing _balances and tokensSold, registering ownership and emitting events.
ERC721._transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId); internal ownership move routine calling _removeNFToken/_addNFToken and updating balances.
ERC721._checkOnERC721Received(...); private hook performing an external call to onERC721Received on the recipient contract and bubbling reverts via assembly.
ERC721._removeNFToken(address _from, uint256 _tokenId); internal swap-and-pop bookkeeping over ownerToIds and idToOwnerIndex.
ERC721._addNFToken(address _to, uint256 _tokenId); internal bookkeeping pushing tokenId into ownerToIds and recording the index.
Address.isContract(address account); library helper using inline assembly extcodesize to test for contract code.
bool private lock; reentrancy guard storage flag toggled by the nonReentrant modifier.
bool public contractPaused; global pause flag checked by buyNFT and birth.
bool public _startSale; gate flag enabling minting entry points.
uint256 internal tokensSold; running counter of minted tokens, used as token id source and supply cap check.
string internal baseURI; metadata prefix returned by _baseURI and mutated by setBaseURI.
address private _owner; Ownable ownership slot.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances; per-owner token balance ledger.
mapping(uint256=>address) private _owners; token id to owner ledger.
mapping(address=>uint256[]) internal ownerToIds; enumerable token list per owner.
mapping(uint256=>uint256) internal idToOwnerIndex; index of a token id inside ownerToIds.
msg.sender (_msgSender()); attacker-controlled caller address used for authorization checks, mint recipients and external call operator argument.
External call IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(_msgSender(),from,tokenId,_data) on an attacker-supplied contract, plus assembly revert bubbling.
Inline assembly extcodesize(account) used for the isContract code-size probe.
Arithmetic tokensSold + quantity supply computation in buyNFT used for the MAX_SUPPLY bound check and for token id derivation.
uint quantity; caller-supplied mint batch size in buyNFT.
uint _tokenId; loop-local token id computed as tokensSold + 1 in buyNFT.
string newURI; caller-supplied metadata prefix in setBaseURI.
bool _paused; caller-supplied pause flag in pauseContract.
uint count; caller-supplied mint amount in devMint.
address recipient; caller-supplied mint destination in devMint.
uint i; loop counter used by devMint and buyNFT minting loops.
bytes _data; forwarded to onERC721Received in _checkOnERC721Received.
address to; destination address parameter of _transfer.
address from; source address parameter of _transfer.

edges.reason: buyNFT calls the internal _mint routine once per loop iteration to create tokens.
birth calls _mint once to create a single token for the caller.
devMint calls _mint inside its count-bounded loop to mint to an arbitrary recipient.
_mint invokes _addNFToken to register the new token in ownerToIds and idToOwnerIndex.
_transfer invokes _removeNFToken to clear the previous owner bookkeeping.
_transfer invokes _addNFToken to register the token under the new owner.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external, attacker-controlled callback onERC721Received that can re-enter the contract before state finalization.
isContract executes the inline assembly extcodesize operation to detect contract accounts.
msg.sender is passed as the owner/recipient argument of _mint in buyNFT and birth.
devMint authorizes the untrusted caller via hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, _msgSender()).
pauseContract authorizes the untrusted caller via hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, _msgSender()).
setBaseURI authorizes the untrusted caller via hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, _msgSender()).
startSale authorizes the untrusted caller via hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, _msgSender()).
_msgSender() is forwarded as the operator argument of the external onERC721Received call.
The caller-supplied quantity feeds the tokensSold + quantity supply computation guarded only by a require.
tokensSold is used as the base addend for the tokensSold + quantity supply bound computation.
The computed supply sum is consumed by buyNFT's require(tokensSold+quantity<=10000) limit check.
The nonReentrant modifier on buyNFT reads and sets the lock guard before and after minting.
The nonReentrant modifier on birth reads and sets the lock guard around the mint.
buyNFT reads the _startSale state flag in its require gate.
buyNFT reads the contractPaused state flag in its require gate.
tokensSold is read to derive the next token id passed into _mint.
_mint increments tokensSold += 1, mutating the global supply counter.
The newURI parameter is written directly into the baseURI state variable.
The _paused parameter is written into the contractPaused state variable.
The count parameter controls the devMint loop bound and total minted amount.
The recipient parameter becomes the owner argument of _mint inside devMint.
The loop counter i drives the devMint minting loop.
The _data blob is forwarded verbatim to the external onERC721Received call.
The to parameter is used by _transfer for the destination bookkeeping and balance update.
The from parameter is used by _transfer for the source ownership check and balance update.
_addNFToken pushes the token id into the ownerToIds mapping of the recipient.
_addNFToken records the new index of the token id in idToOwnerIndex.
ownerToIds lengths, which are derived from tokensSold-driven minting, drive the index arithmetic in _addNFToken.
The local _tokenId is computed inside buyNFT and returned to the caller as the last minted id.
